The Triple Crown race that every Umamusume 
dreams of. The day of the "Kikuka Sho"... 
has arrived.

At the buzzing racetrack, attention was 
focused on the "Mejiro Family" showdown 
between Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan.

Meanwhile, Mejiro McQueen heads into her 
serious showdown against Mejiro Ryan... 
with an air of regal composure.
